items.prompt: Which input handling preserves empty expressions?

options.why: Whitespace tokenization loses empty expressions and shifts character positions by removing spaces.
Stripping each line removes meaningful leading or trailing spaces and changes error positions.
Joining records merges separate expressions and inserts characters not present in the original line.
Splitting records at newline boundaries preserves empty expression records and their within-line spaces when the supplied record count is respected.

items.explanation: Do not erase empty records or spaces.
